scope: Consistent two-sided expanded standalone Hero records; no book release approval

supersedes.reason: Owner rejected the mixed page counts and graphic design, specifically floating headers over blank lines.

visual_review.coverage: All 100 individual page images inspected at contact-sheet scale in 10 contact sheets; 7 full-page details inspected. Pack page identity is checked mechanically against individuals.

contact_sheets.observation: Blank record and opening Hero profiles: identity, attribute, resource, and table boundaries align; section titles are attached to the panels they identify.
Hero profiles share the same front/back division and field bands; each reverse has rules followed by bounded Notes space.
Longer rules fit within their enclosing panels; the Mossgrave reverse continues its long rule at a sentence boundary and retains usable Notes space.
Dense equipment and weapon rules remain inside the front and reverse panels; portraits stay within the identity frame.
Gildmirror has two populated sides with the same identity and rules frames. Unused grey contact-sheet tiles are not PDF pages.

full_page_details.observation: Attached label bands contain their labels; connected identity cells, shield attributes, resources, closed tables, and the real Party Leader checkbox are visible. No detached label or apparent clipping observed.
Known Powers and Talents align with the equipment/Fate stack. The advancement reference is enclosed beneath both columns, and the bottom rules remain above the footer.
Approved portrait sits inside the identity frame; equipment and Basic Mode notes are bounded above the carried-item writing area.
Rules occupy the framed upper area in two columns. The lower Notes frame provides writing space without floating section labels.
Long source rule continues at a sentence boundary across balanced columns without an apparent interrupted sentence; Notes remain inside a separate frame below.
Dense equipment and venom text fit their frame; active Hands and carried-item fields remain distinct and enclosed.
Long Sweep, Light, and Thrown rule text fits the framed columns with Notes below; no apparent overlap or clipping observed.

visual_review.limits: Author observations, not independent review, owner aesthetic approval, every-glyph proof, player testing, or accessibility certification.

capacity_limits: Blank reverse provides 6 Power rows and 11 talent/special-ability rows, plus 3 front trait fields. These are writing capacities, not game limits.
